n/a semantics (studio invariant I3; implemented in modVectors 528, applyDerived 516, termEvents 524, evalExpr 384; audited in audit/m7b-methods/grid.txt — 42 states):
- n/a propagates: arithmetic and comparisons with n/a give n/a; && and || use three-valued (Kleene) logic; ifelse(n/a, …) is n/a; is.na(x) is TRUE/FALSE; filters keep only rows where the expression is TRUE (n/a and FALSE are excluded). Note: the pinned evalSubset compares with NaN, where != and ! give TRUE, so it keeps n/a rows — semantics differ today.
- Modulator policies: reject (default when n/a present; slope not built, explicit choice required), drop_from_term (events with n/a removed from the term: main effect and slopes; announce if a whole condition disappears), zero (n/a contributes 0 after centring; only allowed when the modulator is centred; scaling preserved).
- Centring and SD use observed values only (grid: cell means 0.0000, SD 1.000 under centring + z; n/a entries exactly 0 under zero).
- Binned factors (G22): cut points from the creating term's filtered events pooled over runs, type-7 quantiles, right = FALSE, n/a gets no bin and those events leave the term with a warning; custom breaks printed explicitly as c(-Inf, …, Inf).
- Events with n/a onsets or onsets outside the run are excluded and counted.
Expression language (G38; studio invariant I9; parseExpr 365, evalExpr 384, levelErrors 380): types number, text, logical, n/a; operators + - * / (× ÷ − accepted and normalized), comparisons, && || ! (single & or | rejected with a hint), functions ifelse, in, is.na, abs, log, round, min, max; arithmetic requires numbers; comparisons require matching types; == / != / in() against a text column are checked against its levels ("“failed_stop” is not a level of outcome (levels: …)"); TRUE/FALSE are logical; parse errors give character positions; log of a negative should give n/a, not NaN; filters must be logical per event.
Scaling names (G13/G33/G12): scale(x, center = FALSE) in R is RMS scaling, not SD, so SD-only scaling needs its own name; scale_within_run(x) using the implicit run id; per-event peak normalization by duration (fmridesign duration_hrf_gen) distinct from the integral default.
Acceptance: semantics fixtures for all 42 grid states (expected per-cell means/SD, columns, printed lines in grid.txt and dump1.json), expression unit tests from the mock gate cases (C21, C23, C27, C29, C31 in checks.cjs).

Example studies for fixtures: STUDIES (line 424): block localizer (TR 2, N 180), mixed gambles (N 240; gain, loss, gain×loss), delayed match-to-sample (N 210; sample/delay/probe/errors phases; accuracy), stop signal (N 200; FIR 10×2 s; rt n/a for successful stops, ssd n/a for go), category × attention (N 240; 12 cells × canonical+temporal+dispersion; 24 motion). Runs use seeds 11 and 29; motion from motionSet (418); FD/censoring and confounds in regenMotion (499).
